## Load Data and Signatures

```{r}

cmat <- read.csv('Data/raw_counts.csv')
cmat <- cmat[!duplicated(cmat$Symbol),]
rownames(cmat) <- cmat$Symbol
cmat <- cmat[,3:ncol(cmat)]
colnames(cmat) <- str_replace(colnames(cmat),'\\.','-')
cmat <- as.matrix(cmat)





meta_df <- data.frame(row.names = colnames(cmat),
                      Sample = colnames(cmat),
                      TotalCounts = colSums(cmat))


rm_samples <- './meta/remove_samples.txt'
age_meta <- './meta/patient_meta.csv'
ls_meta <- './meta/LS_Meta.csv'

all_samples <- rownames(meta_df)
age_meta <- read.csv(age_meta,header = T,na.strings = "N/A")
ls_meta <- read.csv(ls_meta, header = T,na.strings = "N/A")

rm_samples <- colnames(read.csv(rm_samples))
meta_df <- meta_df[!rownames(meta_df) %in% rm_samples,]
meta_df$Cond <- NA
meta_df$Cond[str_detect(rownames(meta_df),"CSU")] <- 'CSU'
meta_df$Cond[str_detect(rownames(meta_df),"LS")] <- 'LS'
meta_df$Cond[str_detect(rownames(meta_df),"N")] <- 'CTRL'
meta_df$Cond[str_detect(rownames(meta_df),"CTRL")] <- 'CTRL'
rownames(meta_df) <- str_replace(rownames(meta_df),"\\.","-")

meta_df$Age <- age_meta$Age[match(rownames(meta_df),age_meta$Patient)]
meta_df$Sex <- age_meta$Sex[match(rownames(meta_df),age_meta$Patient)]
meta_df$GCL <- NA
meta_df$GCL[match(ls_meta$Sample.Name,rownames(meta_df))] <- ls_meta$Subtype..HC..Generalized..Circumscribed..Linear.
meta_df$GCL[meta_df$Cond == 'CTRL'] <- 'Healthy'
meta_df$Activity <- NA
meta_df$Activity[match(ls_meta$Sample.Name,rownames(meta_df))] <- ls_meta$Activity..Healthy..Inactive..Active.
meta_df$Activity[meta_df$Cond == 'CTRL'] <- 'Healthy'
meta_df$Group <- NA
meta_df$Group[match(ls_meta$Sample.Name,rownames(meta_df))] <- ls_meta$Group..Fibrotic.Inflammatory.
meta_df$Group[meta_df$Cond == 'CTRL'] <- 'Healthy'
meta_df$Cond[meta_df$Cond == 'CTRL'] <- 'Healthy'

##Align with cmat
cmat <- cmat[,rownames(meta_df)]
table(colnames(cmat) == rownames(meta_df))


##Need to create SummarizedTopicExperiment
imm_se <- SingleCellExperiment(assays = list(counts = cmat))
colData(imm_se) <- as(meta_df,'DFrame')
imm_se <- imm_se[,imm_se$Cond != 'CSU']
library(biomaRt)

# Connect to the Ensembl database
mart <- useMart("ensembl", dataset = "hsapiens_gene_ensembl")

# Get mitochondrial genes (genes located on the mitochondrial genome)
mito_genes <- getBM(
  attributes = c("hgnc_symbol", "ensembl_gene_id", "chromosome_name"),
  filters = "chromosome_name", 
  values = "MT", 
  mart = mart
)

#Background genes
bg.genes <- rownames(imm_se)[
  str_detect(rownames(imm_se),'RPL') |
  str_detect(rownames(imm_se),'RPS') |
  rownames(imm_se) %in% mito_genes$hgnc_symbol
]
library(readr)
LS_Unfiltered <- read_csv("Manuscript/DESeq2/LS_Unfiltered.csv")
bg.genes <- LS_Unfiltered$Symbol[LS_Unfiltered$P.Value > 0.05 & abs(LS_Unfiltered$logFC) < 1]
backup <- imm_se
```

```{r}
#Loading and setting gene signatures
imm_se <- backup
imm_sig <- read.csv("./Data/final_imm_signatures.csv")
imm_sig <- imm_sig %>%
    dplyr::filter(Source == 'Elvis') %>%
    dplyr::filter(str_detect(signature,'Th')) %>%
    dplyr::select(genes,signature) %>%
    dplyr::distinct()

#imm_sig <- imm_sig[imm_sig$genes %in% rownames(imm_se),]

K <- length(unique(imm_sig$signature)) + 1
keep.genes <- intersect(rownames(imm_se),c(imm_sig$genes,bg.genes))
imm_se <- imm_se[keep.genes,]
imm_sig <- imm_sig[imm_sig$genes %in% keep.genes,]
bg.genes <- bg.genes[bg.genes %in% keep.genes & !bg.genes %in% imm_sig$genes]
imm_phi <- matrix(0,nrow = nrow(imm_se),ncol = K)

rownames(imm_phi) <- rownames(imm_se)

imm_sigs <- unique(imm_sig$signature)
colnames(imm_phi) <- c(imm_sigs,'Background')

for (sig in imm_sigs){
  cur_genes <- imm_sig$genes[imm_sig$signature == sig]
  imm_phi[cur_genes,sig] <- 1
  imm_phi[cur_genes,sig] <- imm_phi[cur_genes,sig]/sum(imm_phi[cur_genes,sig])
  
}

#Background topic
imm_phi[bg.genes,K] <- 1/length(bg.genes)
#imm_phi[,K] <- 1/nrow(imm_phi)
table(imm_sig$signature)
```

## Infer Topics

```{r}
imm_se <- SingleCellTopicExperiment(imm_se,
                                K = K)
imm_se$Group <- factor(imm_se$Group,levels = c('Healthy','Inflammatory','I/F','Fibrotic'))
imm_se$Activity <- factor(imm_se$Activity,levels = c('Healthy','Inactive','Active'))
imm_se$Cond <- factor(imm_se$Cond,levels = c('Healthy','LS'))
imm_se$GCL <- factor(imm_se$GCL, levels = c('Healthy','Generalized','Circumscribed','Linear'))

imm_se <- inferTopics(imm_se,
                  num_threads = 6,
                  maxiter = 150,
                  verbal = T,
                  phi = imm_phi)
imm_se <- buildTheta(imm_se)
```

```{r}
theta_df <- theta(imm_se)
colnames(theta_df) <- colnames(imm_phi)
res_df <- cbind(as.data.frame(colData(imm_se)),
                theta_df)

library(reshape2)
res_df <- melt(res_df)
```

```{r}
library(ggpubr)
library(dplyr)

# Assume cur_res is defined as:
cur_res <- res_df %>%
  filter(variable %in% colnames(imm_phi))

# Your predefined comparisons and color lists
ls_compare <- list(
  Group = list( c("Healthy", "Inflammatory"),
                c("Healthy", "Fibrotic"),
                c("Inflammatory", "Fibrotic")),
  Activity = list(c('Healthy','Active')),
  Cond = list(c('Healthy','LS')),
  GCL = list(c('Healthy','Generalized'),
             c('Healthy','Circumscribed'),
             c('Generalized','Circumscribed'))
)


ls_color <- list(
  Group  = c("#00AFBB", "#E7B800", "#FC4E07","#C26EFF"),
  Activity = c("#00AFBB", "#69D045", "#6A0572"),
  Cond = c("#00AFBB",'#E63946'),
  GCL = c("#00AFBB",'#D3D3D3','#808080','#404040'))

all_results <- list()

for (cur_comp in names(ls_compare)) {
  for (cell in unique(cur_res$variable)) {
    # Filter the data for this cell/signature
    cur_res_cell <- cur_res %>% filter(variable == cell)  %>% 
      dplyr::select(variable,cur_comp,value) %>%
      na.omit()
    
    # Apply filters to remove unwanted levels
    if (cur_comp == "Group") {
      cur_res_cell <- cur_res_cell %>% filter(Group != "I/F")
    }
    if (cur_comp == "GCL") {
      cur_res_cell <- cur_res_cell %>% filter(GCL != "Linear")
    }
    if (cur_comp == "Activity") {
      cur_res_cell <- cur_res_cell %>% filter(Activity != "Inactive")
    }
    
    # Calculate means for each group
    group_means <- cur_res_cell %>%
      group_by(!!sym(cur_comp)) %>%
      summarize(mean_value = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
                sd_value = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE),
                n = n())
    
    # Create formula for compare_means
    fml <- as.formula(paste("value ~", cur_comp))
    
    # Run the comparisons using compare_means() from ggpubr
    test_res <- compare_means(
      formula = fml,
      data = cur_res_cell,
      method = "wilcox.test",
      p.adjust.method = "BH",
      comparisons = ls_compare[[cur_comp]]
    )
    
    # Add group means to test results
    test_res <- test_res %>%
      mutate(
        group1_mean = sapply(group1, function(g) {
          group_means$mean_value[group_means[[cur_comp]] == g]
        }),
        group2_mean = sapply(group2, function(g) {
          group_means$mean_value[group_means[[cur_comp]] == g]
        })
      )
    
    # Add columns for the current cell and grouping factor
    test_res <- test_res %>%
      mutate(variable = cell,
             comparison_factor = cur_comp)
    
    all_results[[paste(cur_comp, cell, sep = "_")]] <- test_res
  }
}

# Combine all the results into one data.frame
final_results <- do.call(rbind, all_results)

```

```{r}
all_plots <- list()
for (cur_comp in names(ls_compare)) {
  cur_plots <- list()
  for (cell in unique(cur_res$variable)) {
    # Use the full data for plotting (omit NAs)
    plot_data <- cur_res %>% 
      filter(variable == cell) %>% 
      dplyr::select(variable, !!sym(cur_comp), value) %>%
      na.omit()
    
    # Remove outliers from the data (for jitter and base_y computation)
    # Here we filter separately for each level of the grouping variable.
    plot_data_no_out <- plot_data %>%
      group_by_at(cur_comp) %>%
      #filter(value <= quantile(value, 0.75) + 1.5 * IQR(value)) %>%
      ungroup()
    
    # For the statistics, create a filtered version (without unwanted levels)
    stat_data <- plot_data
    if (cur_comp == "Group") {
      stat_data <- stat_data %>% filter(Group != "I/F")
    }
    if (cur_comp == "GCL") {
      stat_data <- stat_data %>% filter(GCL != "Linear")
    }
    if (cur_comp == "Activity") {
      stat_data <- stat_data %>% filter(Activity != "Inactive")
    }
    
    # Subset the final_results (computed on filtered data) for the current factor and cell
    stat_subset <- final_results %>% 
      filter(variable == cell, comparison_factor == cur_comp)
    
    # Compute a base y.position from the outlier-filtered data so that annotations are high enough
    base_y <- max(plot_data_no_out$value, na.rm = TRUE)
    base_y <- base_y * ifelse(base_y > 0.9, 1, 1.01)
    stat_subset <- stat_subset %>%
      arrange(p.adj) %>%
      mutate(y.position = base_y + (row_number()-1) * 0.005 * base_y)  # adjust step as needed
    
    # Generate the boxplot using the outlier-filtered data
    p <- ggboxplot(plot_data_no_out,
                   x = cur_comp, 
                   y = "value",
                   fill = cur_comp,
                   palette = ls_color[[cur_comp]],
                   add = "jitter",
                   outlier.shape = NA) +
      # Annotate using stat_pvalue_manual with a small step.increase
      stat_pvalue_manual(stat_subset,
                         label = "p.adj",
                         xmin = "group1",
                         xmax = "group2",
                         y.position = "y.position",
                         tip.length = 0.01,
                         bracket.size = 0.5,
                         size = 6,
                         step.increase = 0.05) +  
      theme_minimal(base_size = 20) +
      theme(
        axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 1),
        axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 1)
      ) +
      labs(
        #title = cell,
        x = cur_comp,
        y = "Activity Score"
      )
    
    cur_plots[[cell]] <- p
  }
  all_plots[[cur_comp]] <- cur_plots
}
```

## Clinical Features

```{r}
theta_df <- as.data.frame(theta_df)
clin_df <- read.csv("./Data/Final_Iteration/LS_ClinicalData.csv",header = T)
clin_df  <- clin_df %>%
  filter(Event.Name == 'Landing form')
clin_df$Duration <- clin_df$Age.at.diagnosis..in.years. - clin_df$Age.of.appearance.of.lesion..in.years.
clin_df$Group <- clin_df$Group..Fibrotic.Inflammatory.
clin_df$Subtype <- clin_df$Subtype..HC..Generalized..Circumscribed..Linear.
clin_df$Activity <- clin_df$Activity..Healthy..Inactive..Active.
clin_df <- melt(clin_df)

library(reshape2)

table(clin_df$SAMPLE == rownames(theta(imm_se))[match(clin_df$SAMPLE,rownames(theta_df))])
clin_df$Th1 <- theta_df[match(clin_df$SAMPLE,rownames(theta_df)),]$Th1
clin_df$Th2 <- theta_df[match(clin_df$SAMPLE,rownames(theta_df)),]$Th2
clin_df$Th17 <- theta_df[match(clin_df$SAMPLE,rownames(theta_df)),]$Th17


ggplot(clin_df,aes(x = value, y = Th1,color = Group)) +
  geom_point() +
  facet_wrap(~ variable,scales = "free_x")

clin_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(variable == 'Duration') %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = value, y = log10(Th1),color = Group)) +
    geom_point(size = 5) +
    facet_wrap(~ variable,scales = "free_x") +
    labs(x = 'Time until Diagnosis (Years)') +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 20) +
    theme(
        plot.title = element_text(hjust =  0.5),
        axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 1),  # Thicker axis lines
        axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 1)
      )

```
